name: hipstudio-static

scripts.build: export QUOTE_REQUEST_BASE_URL=${QUOTE_REQUEST_BASE_URL:-https://www.hipstudio.hu}; python3 tools/build.py && python3 tools/enforce_viko_output.py && python3 tools/remove_public_pricing.py
scripts.build:platform: if [ "${BUILD_MODE:-review}" = "production" ]; then python3 tools/assert_production_activation.py || exit $?; fi; export PLATFORM_URL=${PLATFORM_URL:-https://www.hipstudio.hu}; python3 tools/build_platform.py && python3 tools/enrich_flugos_heritage.py && python3 tools/enrich_flugos_sponsors.py && python3 tools/enrich_platform_commercial.py && python3 tools/enrich_partner_logos.py && python3 tools/build_platform_solutions.py && python3 tools/enrich_solution_depth.py && python3 tools/build_platform_services.py && python3 tools/build_quote_request.py && python3 tools/build_privacy_pages.py && python3 tools/humanize_platform_copy.py && python3 tools/enrich_pain_point_ia.py && python3 tools/apply_editorial_shell.py
scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run build:platform && python3 tools/enforce_legal_entity_schema.py
scripts.test: python3 tools/test.py && python3 tools/test_viko_role.py && python3 tools/test_legal_entity_schema.py
scripts.test:all: npm test && npm run test:platform && npm run test:master-brand && npm run test:domain-migration && npm run test:legacy-url-matrix && npm run test:commercial-content && npm run test:solution-depth && npm run test:evidence && npm run test:business-provider && npm run test:release-gates && npm run test:legal-controller && npm run test:privacy-governance && npm run test:privacy-pages && npm run test:hosting && npm run test:service-inventory && npm run test:public-quote && npm run test:quote-routing && npm run test:quote-email-localization && npm run test:no-wix-hotlinks && npm run test:partner-references && npm run test:flugos-sponsors && npm run test:hero-media && npm run test:editorial-shell && npm run test:pain-points && npm run test:pricing

description: HIPStudio master platform for Business, Creative and Flúgos Experiences. hipstudio.hu is published from 880rzz/HIPSTUDIO through GitHub Pages; flugos.hu will use a separate Vercel project as the specialist entry-domain layer without duplicating the master content platform. Privacy governance uses Hipstudió Kft. as controller and Németh Tímea as human contact. Public pricing is suppressed. No automatic production cutover.
